name: What factors influence the cost of drywall installation and remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of drywall installation and remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall remodeling costs depend primarily on room square footage, ceiling height, whether old drywall removal is required, and the desired level of finish. Simple flat walls are faster and less labor-intensive than high ceilings, curved archways, or multi-angle framing. Water damage or storm-damage restoration can add expense if insulation behind the sheetrock must be replaced or structural framing dried out. Choosing a Level 5 smooth wall finish also requires additional skim-coating coats and labor compared to standard textured walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall remodeling costs depend on room dimensions, ceiling height, demolition needs, structural framing complexity, and whether you choose textured walls or a Level 5 smooth finish.
